trello.name: Document prompt injection attempt in security log
trello.desc: Owner: Hassan. Document the prompt injection attempt from the support ticket properly, including the raw ticket content, what the ticket summarizer actually did, and timestamps. File it in the security log with a severity assessment. Deadline: this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against prompt injection
trello.desc: Owner: Wren. Add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser so that quoted customer content is delimited and treated as data when sent to the summarizer, with instruction-like content stripped or neutralized. Turn this exact ticket into a test fixture as a regression test that feeds the ticket through and checks the summary stays clean. Also add an eval that runs a small suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy. Approved by Grace; fold the eval into the same task.

trello.name: Investigate jdoe443 account and password reset delivery
trello.desc: Owner: Wren. Check the reset email delivery logs for the last week and follow up on the account jdoe443 mentioned in the injection ticket. If the account is a burner, close it. If password resets are actually broken, that becomes its own incident.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts since May
trello.desc: Owner: Hassan. Provide Grace with the list of service accounts created since May for use in the quarterly access review. Deadline: Thursday.
